narrative.overview:
GapMouse is the door hanger on your desk: one face, one word, readable from across the room, turned over when the state changes. The window is opened from the tray for a few seconds to confirm the app is doing its job, so the first thing seen is a full-height card in the colour of the current state with the state word in bold caps. Everything else is quiet instrument-panel reading on a tinted charcoal ground.

The voice is calm, legible and native to Windows: Segoe UI Variable throughout, rank by weight and case inside one tight scale, one corner radius family and one hairline weight on every surface. Precision and restraint (Operate mode). The system rejects one thing outright: a grey Fluent tab strip with a status dot and a form.
keyCharacteristics: Three committed state fields (cobalt, green, amber), each with its own ink; the hanger face is the only large colour on screen.
Flat, tonal layering: ground, card-stock rail, surface cards separated by hairlines, never shadows.
Live values sit in fixed cells with tabular numerals so nothing jitters.
Stamped and steady: fixed-width log tags, a single short flip as the only motion.
Dark and light themes with the same structure; state fields and log tag fills are identical in both.

rules.name: The Committed State Rule
rules.body: A state owns a whole field of colour with its own paired ink; never a dot, badge or tint of it. Colour on the face is state, nowhere else.

rules.name: The Ink Pairing Rule
rules.body: Text on a state field uses that state's ink tokens (primary and secondary), not the theme text colours. Amber is the only dark-ink field.

rules.name: The Fixed Tag Table Rule
rules.body: Log tag colours are a fixed table identical in both themes. White ink except on amber.

rules.name: The Tabular Cell Rule
rules.body: Any value that changes while the window is open uses tabular numerals in a fixed, right-aligned cell.

rules.name: The Weight-and-Case Rank Rule
rules.body: Rank is carried by weight and case inside the 11-12-14-16-20-30 scale; do not add sizes or a second family.

rules.name: The Flat-Always Rule
rules.body: No drop shadows, glows or blur. Separate with tone and the single hairline.

dos: Do give each state its whole face: cobalt #2F5FD0, green #157545, amber #E3A21A with their paired inks.
Do use 12px for cards and the face, 6px for controls and tags, and the 1px hairline for every edge.
Do put changing numbers in tabular, right-aligned cells.
Do keep one accent button per view and everything else default or quiet.
Do keep state and tag fills identical across light and dark; only the neutrals change.
Do keep log tags and on-disk log words in English tags at a fixed 76px width.
donts: Don't build the category default: a grey Fluent tab strip with a status dot and a form.
Don't use shadows, glows or blur for depth.
Don't signal state with a dot, badge or tint; use the face field and its word.
Don't add a second typeface, extra type sizes, or a second corner radius family.
Don't put theme text colours on a state field; use the state's ink tokens.
Don't animate anything except the face flip (0.22s ease-out).
